name: Animation trigger
description: Starts an animation path or group when a player comes near (lifts, platforms). MSR 'Lifts and moving platforms'.

fields.name: exitRadius
fields.description: with pauseOnExit, leaving this radius pauses again

fields.name: flags
fields.description: 0x80 path; 0x40 explosion triggers it; 0x20 no group set-up; 0x01 keep playing

fields.name: pauseOnExit
fields.description: non-zero: pause on leaving the exit radius

fields.name: pathSound
fields.description: sound started on the path, 0 = none
